decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's established consumer health offer and has its own page, so the firm can readily interpret results and refine the line with its in-house development.
The skin and hair supplement extends the existing pharmacy supplement line, which the firm understands well, and it was actively promoted at launch with a dedicated page.
The joint health product sits under the established Trivital brand, so the firm's related knowledge and quality capabilities let it learn from early sales and improve the product.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is related to the firm's supplement know-how but more niche and only mentioned on the website, so it faces a somewhat higher, though still modest, risk of being dropped.

The generic valsartan lies far from the firm's established offer and was hit by the 2018 contamination recall, leaving the firm with little related knowledge to resolve the problem, so withdrawal is likely.
